tagline: Leading IP Licensing Platform for Media, Entertainment and Semiconductors
hero_kpi_rationale: 18% revenue growth ($67.4 million increase), demonstrating strong commercial traction of the IP licensing platform in the media, entertainment, and semiconductor sectors.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue increased from $376.0 million in 2024 to $443.4 million in 2025, representing an 18% year-over-year increase.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by IP licensing platform

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from fixed-fee and minimum-guarantee arrangements
kpis.description: Recurring revenues increased from $341.5 million in 2024 to $351.3 million in 2025, representing a 3% year-over-year increase and demonstrating contract stability.
kpis.signal: Stable recurring revenue base from established customer relationships

kpis.name: Patent Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total media and semiconductor patent assets worldwide
kpis.description: Adeia maintains approximately 13,750 media and semiconductor patent assets worldwide, with approximately 80% generated from internal innovation engine.
kpis.signal: Extensive IP portfolio supporting competitive advantage

kpis.name: Employees
kpis.description: Adeia operates with approximately 150 full-time employees, substantially all located in the U.S., demonstrating an efficient asset-light business model.
kpis.signal: Lean, asset-light IP licensing business model

kpis.name: AI Innovation
kpis.explanation: Company addressing AI as evolving technology and market opportunity
kpis.description: Adeia's innovations address massive proliferation of entertainment content and evolving technology including artificial intelligence, positioning the company for next-generation solutions.
kpis.signal: AI recognized as key consumer trend and innovation focus area

kpis.name: Media & Semiconductor IP
kpis.explanation: Dual-industry IP licensing platform serving entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor sectors
kpis.description: Adeia operates a leading IP licensing platform with extensive portfolio of media and semiconductor intellectual property, enabling customers to build next-generation solutions for global markets.
kpis.signal: Differentiated IP licensing business across complementary industries

ai_positioning.summary: Adeia recognizes artificial intelligence as an evolving technology and key consumer trend. The company explicitly mentions AI as part of innovations addressing market changes in entertainment and consumer technology, though AI represents an emerging opportunity rather than a primary business focus.
evidence: Our innovations address one of the biggest consumer trends in entertainment today: the massive proliferation of entertainment content and the rapidly changing habits of how consumers are finding, engaging with and enjoying entertainment and evolving technology, such as artificial intelligence (AI).
